scope: Three familiar unchanged original synthetic cases, one repetition each, fixed order; only thinking enabled in the same selection contract.

must: Select the whole unambiguous sending undertaking, preserving Next Tuesday and recorded speaker/time.
Retain surviving invoice sending together with complete original compound and withdrawal context in associated neutral review.
Human resolves current work; no current-task assertion and no demand to reproduce a single authored group array.
Select no work groups from the availability question and affirmative status answer.

request_budget.proposal: Three synthetic cases, thinking enabled; fixed prompt/schema/renderer; three requests/180s each/600s overall/no retries; stop critical or technical failure.

critical: Omitting the straightforward genuine undertaking from selected review.
Omitting surviving invoice sending or materially losing/misassociating its original/withdrawal context.
Materially misleading grouping or changed source meaning/attribution/conditions.
Invented task/currentness/owner/deadline assertion or writing represented as speech.
noncritical: Irrelevant availability/fact/request-only selection, unnecessary groups/repetition or review burden without material meaning distortion.
Availability-only nonempty groups fail that case criterion; neutral source selection alone is not a fabricated task assertion.
interpretation: All supplied refs validate; normalization and literal rendering establish structure/provenance, not meaning or complete coverage.
Required refs are source-based coverage anchors, not exact expected array match. Judge actual rendered association and burden.
A full transcript annex or generic warning cannot rescue missing selected work.
All original writing stays separate/unchanged and excluded from model input.
Chief agent assesses each saved valid output before next request, including the final/empty result; no automatic model quality PASS.
Unsent/missing replies are incomplete and ungraded, never invented wrong-answer evidence.

cached_false_comparator.new_partial_wire_difference: Only think:false becomes think:true; same complete snapshot, prompt, schema, model, stream and options.

stopping_rule: Stop at first critical defect identified by Chief review, invalid output, transport/identity/storage/assessment/deadline failure; no retry, resume, replacement or unused-slot transfer.
limits: Familiar development cases, not held out or blinded.
One repetition with a cached prior false observation; no reliable causal attribution or general quality estimate.
Order/load/cache/thinking/version/token/timing limits must be disclosed from actual saved evidence.
No prompt/schema/renderer change, production integration/model switch, historical regrading, saved effort, full40/full-draft or M10 acceptance.
